messages:
dmitri: Heads-up — kicking off a short access pulse for cross-account admin KMS bindings. Audit logs show a lot of noisy temp grants from last month, want to triage and prune before the quarterly recert.
ellie: SGTM. Which key families are noisy? dev vs prod?
maria: If you can paste a sample log line I can run a quick grep across the audit store.
dmitri: Sample from CloudTrail:
```
2026-02-12T14:03:22Z AWSKMS RevokeGrant AuthPrincipal=arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/dev-operator GrantId=abcd-1234 IssuedBy=service-account@example.com
```
Most of the noise is in the `alias/dev-*` and `alias/staging-*` key aliases. Also seeing `AssumeRole` chains that create short-lived grants.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: kms-binding-noise spike (x5) on dev keys in last 72h — dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/alerts/kms-noise
ellie: We should check retention/ingest gaps first — don't want to accidentally remove active grants. @maria can you run `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/dev-access --query 'Grants[*].{id:GrantId,principal:GranteePrincipal}'` and share results?
maria: Running now. Will filter for grants older than 30d and principals not in current oncall/owner map.
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-1248 for the pulse and added triage label.
maria: Quick results: found 8 grants for `alias/dev-access` where the grantee principal is a cross-account role that was deleted ~2025-11-01. Also 3 grants for `alias/staging-pipelines` issued by a CI user that rotated last month. Recommend revoking the stale grants and scheduling a short canary for `alias/dev-access` first.
dmitri: What's the revoke command? Any atomic-safe steps?
maria: Use revoke sequence:
```
# list grants
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/dev-access --query 'Grants[*].{id:GrantId,principal:GranteePrincipal}'
# revoke one
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/dev-access --grant-id <grant-id>
```
Plan: revoke 1-2 stale grants, run quick CI smoke on a canary repo, then revoke the rest if no failures. I'll run from my temp bastion with `--profile infra-admin`.
ellie: Also please update audit retention tag for the keys to ensure we keep 90 days of evidence for the recert. I can patch the runbook with the retention snippet.
maria: OK I'm taking ownership. ETA 45m for initial canary revoke and smoke. I'll post GRANT IDs and revoke output here.
dmitri: Thanks. If we hit an unexpected failure, we rollback by re-creating the grant via the recorded grant params in the audit logs (not ideal but ok). Keep paging if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
maria: Revoke done for 2 stale grants on `alias/dev-access`. Smoke-run green for canary repo. Re-running list shows remaining 6 stale grants — will schedule batched revokes spaced 5m apart.
ops-bot: Deployment note: canary smoke passed and no high-sev alerts in last 10m.
dmitri: Nice. Please add the final list of removed GrantIds to SEC-1248 and mark the action as complete once batched revokes finish.
maria: Will do. I'll also add a short snippet to the runbook for future pulses and a query to detect cross-account principals without owners.
ellie: Awesome — thanks team. :party:
